note: Generated from the reference implementation at BruceLanLan/tapeapi@4a1ac4fe2a0b2e3327652a794794765dd5da98ef (TapeAPI 1.8.1, with the option labels: 'v2') (sdk/src/group.js, sdk/src/channel.js, sdk/src/canon.js) and reproduced by it (every value and every outcome). Byte strings are lowercase hex with 0x, except inside roster and invite objects and in prev, which are written as a roster carries them (bare hex for gid and prev). Every field is an input or an exact expected output; sdkCode and sdkError are the reference implementation's error code and message and are informative only.
covers: Inputs a receiver must reject (and, where marked, accept) under §5.4, §5.5 and §6.3. Each case names the receiver (a member of epoch.json, or the outsider below), the wires it accepted before and the clock (now, Unix seconds) at each; receiver.gid, when present, is the group the receiver joined instead of epoch.json's. Channel records (§5.4 step 6) are taken to hold exactly the keys listed. "duplicate" means ignored without error. Epoch messages marked owner-signed were re-signed by the owner after the change; the others keep the signature of the original.
